actions_title: Our work in the Paris Region
actions_subtitle: Supporting people today to build a better tomorrow
actions_intro: In the Paris Region, we work every day alongside people facing hardship, providing practical and sustainable solutions.
actions_assistance_description: We provide immediate, tailored assistance to people facing hardship, including access to essential goods, social support and guidance towards appropriate services.
actions_reintegration_description: We support people throughout their social and professional reintegration journey through training, personalised assistance and a network of partners.
actions_homeless_description: We work directly in the field to provide practical and compassionate support to homeless people through outreach, emergency accommodation and guidance towards sustainable solutions.
africa_actions_description: Our delegations also carry out initiatives to combat infectious diseases in West Africa, working alongside local communities.
africa_actions_info: This section will soon be expanded with more information about our work and projects in Africa.
about_subtitle: Beyond aid: a mission of heart and hope
about_intro_1: We believe that every person deserves to be respected, listened to and supported, whatever their circumstances. Our mission combines material assistance, moral support and human connection.
about_intro_2: By considering each person as a whole, we help them rediscover the resources, opportunities and confidence they need to move forward.
about_value_autonomy_description: To help everyone rebuild their lives.
about_history_summary: Born from a desire to act against inequality and social exclusion, FEMAPE Initiative supports people who need it most. From France to Burkina Faso, our work has gradually grown around one shared conviction: putting people at the heart of solidarity.
about_history_paragraph_1: FEMAPE Initiative was born at a time when the urgency to act could be felt on every street corner and in every encounter. Founded with the determination to address growing inequality and social exclusion, our organization quickly evolved into a force for change and hope. Every stage of our development has been guided by one mission: to be there where needs are greatest, without ever losing sight of our shared humanity.
about_history_paragraph_2: The expansion of our work beyond France, particularly with the opening of a branch in Burkina Faso, reflects our commitment to providing assistance wherever it is needed, regardless of borders or nationality. This step marked the beginning of our international presence and reflects our vision of solidarity without limits, capable of transcending cultural and geographical barriers to reach every life with the same dedication.
about_history_image_alt: A FEMAPE Initiative volunteer interacting with a child during a community support initiative
about_approach_understand_description: Every situation is unique. We take the time to listen and understand so that we can provide an appropriate response.
about_approach_together_description: We work with local organizations, institutions and people on the ground to combine our skills and expertise.
about_approach_autonomy_description: We adapt our actions to help everyone regain their place in society and build lasting independence.
about_solidarity_description: A donation, your time or simply sharing our cause: every commitment helps build a fairer and more inclusive world.
about_solidarity_image_alt: A FEMAPE Initiative volunteer talking with someone receiving support
